owner: TRUST; the person's pages render it verbatim; the .md beside it is generated from this file
title: Before you join: let {owner} send you asks
lede: {owner} uses person.tools to send short asks to people they know: a question with a few choices, a link to open, or a small thing to do. {owner} sent you this link. ({owner} is the name on their account, checked by person.tools.) person.tools is new and still in preview: it is free, and it may change.

sections.label: Unpaid
sections.text: Nobody is paid here, and no ask here may ask you for money.

sections.label: Who asks
sections.text: Only {owner}. Each ask is one question with a few choices, one link to open or one step to do. {owner} can also pass on an ask they received; it then shows who asked it first and that {owner} passed it on. Nobody else can call you or send you asks here, and no stranger's call ever reaches you here.

sections.label: What {owner} sees
sections.text: Your answer, any note you add, and when you answered, under the name this link was made for (or the one you choose when you join). {owner} knows it is you; that is the point. When {owner} passes on someone else's ask, the first asker gets your answer, never your name.

sections.label: What person.tools checks
sections.text: Each ask's size, its links and that it carries no password or key. Every link shows the real address it goes to, and a link to a sign-in page is marked as one. person.tools does not screen what {owner} asks you the way it screens calls from strangers.

sections.label: How many
sections.text: You choose how many asks {owner} may send you in a day: 20 unless you change it, from 0 to 100. Over that, an ask waits until your next day.

sections.label: When you are rung
sections.text: Your phone rings only for an ask {owner} marks “now”: once, outside your quiet hours (no rings between 9 PM and 8 AM your time unless you change it). Every other ask waits on your list. A call from a stranger never rings you here. Mute {owner} and nothing rings, but asks still arrive. An ask's alert says only who is asking, never what they wrote, unless you turn on “Show the ask in my alerts” in your settings; then it may show the ask's first line, up to 80 characters. Your phone's own preview setting still decides what shows on a locked screen.

sections.label: Stop, leave, delete
sections.text: Mute, block or leave at any time. Leaving stops {owner}'s asks and deletes your answers to them. On your page, one tap deletes your account, your answers and their records. They are deleted from the service at once, and from every copy within 30 days.

sections.label: How long we keep it
sections.text: An open ask waits until you answer it or its time runs out (at most 30 days). Answered asks stay in your history for 180 days, or less if you delete them. A photo or clip in an ask is deleted on the schedule you set (7 days unless you change it, from 1 to 30).

sections.label: Who to reach
sections.text: Write to hello@person.tools. It reaches person.tools's operator, not {owner}.

sections.label: Adults only
sections.text: This is for adults in the United States.

footnote: This notice is what holds while person.tools is in its preview, and every promise on it is kept. The service's longer terms and privacy notice are still drafts and are not in force.
